title: Page 10
content_zh:
「你这个爱妻狂魔怎么可能让她自己出钱？」俞思邈没想到随口一句话，能问出如此惊人的内幕，回头一定要跟舞能说。

听到兄弟的话，龚昊天又更闷了。「她坚持。」

「她坚持，你也可以坚持啊。」俞思邈低喊。他龚昊天是什么人？大学时代不顾他爸反对，坚持要搞网络公司，如果他是会乖乖听别人的话的人，那还是龚昊天吗？

「我的坚持在她面前不算什么。」龚昊天又好想叹气。

「哈哈哈！谁让你是爱妻狂魔。」

俞思邈懂了，这次兄弟的爱妻行为不是表现在「付出欲」，而是一个字——让。

他一手搭在好兄弟的肩膀上，拍了拍，表示安慰，见兄弟仍有些在意，他替他分析分析情况，「不过话说回来，反正如斯已经嫁给你，口袋里没钱也没关，听侻你二十四小时釆取迫盯人政策，管吃管睡管休息，照顾得这么周到，有没有钱应该没多大关系。」

「那倒是。」龚昊天想了想，斜嘴一笑。

「两位男士开会啊？」于舞能双手捧着大肚子，双脚踩着一寸高的高跟鞋，大步大步走到他们面前。

今天是如斯的大日子，她让餐厅公休一天，把所有人都调过来帮忙，就为了开幕典礼能圆满。

「老婆，小心慢慢走。」俞思邈见太座驾到，又走得如此漫不经心，赶紧上前搀扶，一切小心为上。

「放心，我走得非常慢，这次艺廊的餐点我也都没烦恼，全权交给高大哥处理。」于舞能看着俞思迎笑得很甜。「我可是非常认真在养胎喔。」

「你做得非常正确，老婆。」俞思邈赶紧称赞。

龚昊天听他们说话，受了刺激，转头四处找寻如斯，找了半天，赫然惊见她居然爬上梯子，正在调整一幅画。

他几个大步冲过去，二话不说，直接将人从梯子上抱下来，安稳放到地面上。

「你干么？」他语气里没有一丝责备，只有浓浓的无奈和担心受怕。

「这句话应该是我问你才对吧？」见他脸色阴晴不定，如斯主动解释，「我稍微调整一下画的角度。」

「以后你要做这类事，叫我来帮你。」龚昊天命令道。

「就调整个角度，又不是很难的事，连梯子也才踩上去一格而已，一点也不危险。」她丝毫不觉得这有什么，她踏上去前，也是经过拿捏和思考的，就是觉得没什么危险，才敢踩上去。

听见她的话，他的脸色更难看了，不过他还是舍不得真的对她生气，「孙如斯，你忘记自己答应过我什么吗？」

「我答应你很多事情，你说的是哪一件？」如斯嘴角含笑。「是我答应嫁给你？还是答应替你生小宝宝？还是答应要一辈子跟你在一起？还是答应生生世世都要嫁给你？」

她口中每飘出一个答应，他脸上的阴沉就略减一分，听到最后哪还有半点阴霾痕迹，完全呈现春暖花开的微笑。

「艺厕开幕前你答应过我，凡事以身体为重。」龚昊天双手环抱住她，掌心贴着她的肚子。

他这个老婆事业心比他还重。

两人结婚时，他答应过她，全力协助她两年之内把艺廊弄起来，没想到第二年艺廊这边的事正忙，她居然还怀孕了。

看她身体里忙着孕育宝贵的小生命，工作上也要忙着筹划，他曾经向她提议过艺廊开幕的事能不能暂缓一年，等宝宝生下来再说？

如斯想了两天，驳回他的提案。

从此，如斯的身体归他管，由他负责照顾，她则忙着自己的新事业，也算是夫妻俩分工合作，齐心协力共创美好家庭。

也不知道是不是孩子带来福气，自从如斯怀孕后，他的公司一帆风顺，基本上没什么大事，如果有事，电脑也都能解决。

他的主要工作，就是在尾牙的时候，加码送红包、发红利、发股票，外加给核心人员加薪升官。

他发现与其亲自管理公司，不如让人才发挥专业，自己省力，人才尽力，公司赚大利，顺达成三赢局而。

「我没忘，就算不顾自己的身体，也一定不会忘记要照顾我们的宝宝。」如斯顺着他话说道。

龚昊天正要再说两句，就听见有人喊她——

「如斯。」

「吴卫然？」如斯转头，看见吴卫然和蒋婷悦一起出现，脸上堆起一抹笑容。「你们怎么来了？」

听说他们前年开始年底评分制度，过年前走了三分之一的员工，去年年底还没到，又走了近二分之一的员工。

「不欢迎？」吴卫然扯唇笑了一下。

「怎么会。」如斯维持着脸上的笑容，伸手往四周一摆，举止落落大方，俨然已是老板的派头。「请随便看看。」

「你的艺廊很有味道。」吴卫然目光缓缓扫过艺廊内的每一个细节。「当初同意让你职，让公司损失一员大将，是我的失策。」

听见吴卫然的话，如斯没有接话。

倒是蒋婷悦不服气地道：「公司今年报表非常漂亮，有些人虽然不是奇才，但只要环境给予足够压力，也能够成为人才。」她看向如斯的眼神仍旧充满敌意。

如斯看了眼蒋婷悦，转头向吴卫然要求道：「卫然，我能不能跟你私下谈两句？」

吴卫然虽有些诧异，但马上欣然答应，「当然。」

「昊天？」如斯看向身边始终紧紧搂着自己的老公。

「五分钟后，我来找你。」」龚昊天这话是看着吴卫然说的。

就五分钟？吴卫然苦笑一下。

直到龚昊天和蒋婷悦离开，他们才开始说话。

「你想跟我说什么？」吴卫然问道。

「公司今年的财务报表真的很漂亮？」如斯没看向吴卫然，视线反而追着龚昊天跑。

只见他一离开自己身边，立刻有异性黏上前，其中包括蒋婷悦。

龚昊天把小慧、阿杰、小胖喊过去都忙招呼，蒋婷悦一看见被自己弄走的小胖，识趣的晃到别处去。

「销售业绩不如以往，财务报表之所以漂亮，是因为人事成本压低。」吴卫然跟她说了大实话。

「你还要继续那个评分制度？」如斯也不拐弯抹角。

吴卫然没有说话半天后才缓缓吐了一句，「如果你想回公司，公司随时欢迎你。」

「谢谢。」如斯朝他笑了笑。

两人又聊了几句，吴卫然就告辞了，蒋婷悦看到了，连忙跟上。

「聊完了？」见吴卫然离开，龚昊天很快回到她身边，搀着她日渐沉重的身体。

「嗯。」如斯看着吴卫然和蒋婷悦离开的背影，心里有说不出的感慨。囯中时候的自己，能想象得到如今这幅场景吗？

「这里交给小慧他们，我们回家休息了吧？」龚昊天见她心情似乎有些低落，提议道。

「今天是开幕，我得在这里坐镇。」如斯看看周围，并不想离开。

「一天只能工作四小时，直到把孩子生下来，这是你答应我的。」他祭出两人先前的约定。

「好好好，我交代一下就跟你回家休息。」见他微微皱眉，她知道她今天工作到现在，已经是他的极限。

「如斯，我不是要约束你。」和工作人打过招呼后，龚昊天扶着她慢慢往座车移动。

「我知道，你是心疼我。」如斯也伸手环抱住他腰际，将头轻轻靠在他胸膛上，感觉像已经到家了一样，「就像我规定你不准把工作带回家、一天只能工作八小时、一周只能跟员工一样工作五天。」

"How could you, a wife-loving maniac, let her pay for it on her own?" Yu Simiao didn't expect that a casual sentence could lead to such an astonishing inside story. He must tell Wu Neng later.

Hearing his brother's words, Gong Haotian became even more depressed."She insisted."

"She insists, you can insist too." Yu Simiao shouted.Who is Gong Haotian?In college, he ignored his father's objections and insisted on starting an Internet company. If he was someone who would listen to others, would he still be Gong Haotian?

"My persistence is nothing in front of her." Gong Haotian wanted to sigh again.

"Hahaha! Who makes you a wife-loving maniac?"

Yu Simiao understood that this time the brother's love for his wife was not expressed in "desire to give", but in one word - letting.

He put a hand on his good brother's shoulder, patted him, and expressed comfort. Seeing that his brother was still a little concerned, he analyzed the situation for him, "But having said that, I'm already married to you anyway, so it doesn't matter if I don't have any money in my pocket. I heard that you have a man-to-man policy 24 hours a day, and you have food, sleep, sleep, and rest. You take such good care of me, so it shouldn't matter much whether you have money or not."

"That's true." Gong Haotian thought for a while and smiled sideways.

"Are two gentlemen having a meeting?" Yu Wuneng held her big belly in both hands and strode up to them in one-inch high heels.

Today was such a big day, she asked the restaurant to take a day off and called everyone over to help, just so that the opening ceremony could be a success.

"Honey, be careful and walk slowly." When Yu Simiao saw his wife arriving and walking so carelessly, he quickly stepped forward to help her. He was careful in everything.

"Don't worry, I'm walking very slowly. I don't have to worry about the meals at the gallery this time. I leave it all to Brother Gao." Yu Wuneng looked at Yu Siying and smiled sweetly."I am taking care of my baby very seriously."

"You did it right, wife." Yu Simiao quickly praised.

Gong Haotian was stimulated by what they were talking about, and turned around to look for Ruzi. After searching for a long time, he was surprised to see her climbing up the ladder and adjusting a painting.

He rushed over in a few strides and without saying a word, directly lifted the person off the ladder and placed him safely on the ground.

"What are you doing?" There was no trace of blame in his tone, only deep helplessness and worry.

"I should be asking you this, right?" Seeing his uncertain expression, he took the initiative to explain, "I'll slightly adjust the angle of the painting."

"If you want to do this kind of thing in the future, ask me to help you." Gong Haotian ordered.

"Just adjust the angle. It's not that difficult. Even the ladder only goes up one step, so it's not dangerous at all." She didn't think it was anything at all. She thought carefully before stepping on it. She just felt that there was no danger before she dared to step on it.

Hearing her words, his face turned even darker, but he still couldn't bear to be really angry with her, "Sun Rusi, have you forgotten what you promised me?"

"I promise you many things, which one are you talking about?" With a smile on his face."Do I promise to marry you? Or do I promise to give birth to a baby for you? Or do I promise to be with you for the rest of my life? Or do I promise to marry you for the rest of my life?"

Every time a promise came out of her mouth, the gloom on his face became slightly lighter. At the end, there was no trace of gloom at all, and he completely showed a warm and spring smile.

"You promised me before the art toilet opened that you would put your body first in everything." Gong Haotian put his arms around her, his palms against her belly.

His wife is more career-minded than he is.

When the two got married, he promised her that he would fully assist her in setting up the art gallery within two years. Unexpectedly, the art gallery was busy in the second year, and she actually got pregnant.

Seeing that her body was busy giving birth to a precious little life, and she was also busy planning at work. He once suggested to her that the opening of the art gallery could be postponed for a year until the baby was born?

After thinking about it for two days, he rejected his proposal.

From then on, such a body was under his control and he was responsible for taking care of it, while she was busy with her new career. It was also a division of labor between the couple, working together to create a beautiful family.

I don't know if the child is a blessing. Since becoming pregnant, his company has been going smoothly. Basically, there are no major problems. If there is any problem, the computer can solve it.

His main job is to send extra red envelopes, bonuses, and stocks at the end of the year, as well as give salary increases and promotions to core personnel.

He found that instead of managing the company himself, it was better to let the talents display their professionalism, save himself effort, let the talents do their best, and the company make big profits, thus achieving a win-win situation.

"I haven't forgotten. Even if I don't care about my own body, I will never forget to take care of our baby." Rusi followed his words.

Just as Gong Haotian was about to say a few more words, she heard someone calling her——

"That's it."

"Wu Weiran?" He turned around and saw Wu Weiran and Jiang Tingyue appearing together, with a smile on his face."Why are you here?"

I heard that they started a year-end grading system the year before last, and one-third of the employees were dismissed before the Chinese New Year. Before the end of last year, nearly one-half of the employees were dismissed.

"Not welcome?" Wu Weiran pulled his lips and smiled.

"How could that be?" He kept the smile on his face and waved his hands around, acting calmly and gracefully, as if he was a boss."Please take a look."

"Your art gallery is very interesting." Wu Weiran's eyes slowly scanned every detail in the art gallery."I made a mistake when I agreed to give you the job and cost the company a general."

Hearing Wu Weiran's words, he didn't answer.

Jiang Tingyue, however, was unconvinced and said: "The company's financial statements this year are very beautiful. Although some people are not geniuses, they can become talents as long as the environment puts enough pressure." Her eyes were still full of hostility when she looked at them.

Rusi glanced at Jiang Tingyue, turned to Wu Weiran and asked, "Wei Ran, can I have a few words with you in private?"

Although Wu Weiran was a little surprised, he immediately agreed, "Of course."

"Haotian?" He looked at her husband who was always hugging her tightly.

"I'll come find you in five minutes." Gong Haotian said this while looking at Wu Weiran.

Just five minutes?Wu Weiran smiled bitterly.

They didn't start talking until Gong Haotian and Jiang Tingyue left.

"What do you want to say to me?" Wu Weiran asked.

"The company's financial statements this year are really beautiful?" He didn't look at Wu Weiran, but his eyes followed Gong Haotian.

As soon as he left her side, people of the opposite sex immediately approached him, including Jiang Tingyue.

Gong Haotian called Xiaohui, Ajie, and Xiaopang over and hurriedly greeted them. When Jiang Tingyue saw Xiaopang who had been taken away by him, she moved to another place in an amused manner.

"Sales performance is not as good as before. The reason why the financial statements are beautiful is that personnel costs have been reduced." Wu Weiran told her the truth.

"Are you going to continue that scoring system?" That's not mincing words.

Wu Weiran didn't speak for a long time before he slowly said, "If you want to return to the company, the company welcomes you at any time."

"Thank you." Rusu smiled at him.

The two chatted for a few more words, and Wu Weiran left. Jiang Tingyue saw it and quickly followed.

"Have you finished chatting?" Seeing Wu Weiran leave, Gong Haotian quickly returned to her side and supported her increasingly heavy body.

"Yeah." Looking at Wu Weiran and Jiang Tingyue's leaving figures, I felt unspeakable emotion in my heart.When I was in junior high school, could I have imagined this scene now?

"Leave this place to Xiaohui and the others. Let's go home and rest?" Gong Haotian suggested when he saw that she seemed to be in a low mood.

"Today is the opening, I have to sit here." Looking around like this, I don't want to leave.

"You can only work four hours a day until the child is born. This is what you promised me." He mentioned the previous agreement between the two.

"Okay, okay, I'll tell you and I'll go home and rest with you." Seeing him frowning slightly, she knew that her work today had reached his limit.

"So, I don't want to restrain you." After greeting the staff, Gong Haotian helped her move slowly to the car.

"I know, you feel sorry for me." Rusu also put her arms around his waist and rested her head gently on his chest, feeling as if she was already at home. "It's like I stipulated that you are not allowed to take your work home, you can only work eight hours a day, and you can only work five days a week like employees."
